I am analyzing the regional adaptation of a product since its first launch. This product features innovative characteristics including: a redesigned layout that relocates core power components from the traditional head position to the handle, equipped with a high-frequency temperature monitoring system using thermal sensing technology, and employs Air Multiplier technology to enhance performance efficiency. Please compile the official launch information and core specifications for all consumer-facing models (excluding professional "HD Pro" salon versions) released between April 2016 and December 2024 in the U.S., China, and Japan. Omit any special-edition colorways that did not introduce new hardware. For each qualifying model-region pair, capture the following information: Region (U.S., China, Japan), Model Code (e.g., HD01, HD03), First Retail Availability Date (in format YYYY-MM), Launch MSRP, Number of Included Attachments in a standard set, Warranty Term in years.

Present the compiled data in a Markdown table with the following column names: Region, Model Code, First Retail Availability Date, Launch MSRP, Number of Included Attachments, Warranty(yrs).If any field is unavailable, enter NA.Launch MSRPs are launch-time official prices in the local market currency.When filling in the model, only two letters and numbers are required, for example: HD01.Use only Arabic numerals in Number of Included Attachments and Warranty(yrs).

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the column without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
